verdict.rationale: Gemini's first-party docs describe Deep Research in Gemini Apps for 'in-depth and real-time research on almost any subject.' It uses Google Search by default and can also draw on Gmail, Drive, uploaded files and NotebookLM notebooks, which covers launching a multi-source research run. However, the evidence never explicitly describes the output as a report with citations or details the autonomous multi-step browsing, and no community or hands-on item corroborates it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cited report output, detail on the autonomous search process, independent corroboration.
